book.name: 1 KORIN
book.title: KORIN KHRISAWBU KHATEI PAUL CAKUA UIKHEHNAH

content: Biaphynah le rei thuilypaw lahsong
Donah tua heh a zawng la, Thlawpaw lahsong sahlo hmuh a zawng my lo. Biaphykhynah lahsong khah hmuh a zawng dang my lo.

Zecawtamaw tatah rei thuilypaw tah a reipaw taco cawngsaw khatah a reipaw cang lytah Khazing khatah a reipaw a cang hri. A ngetei tah pawco, a reipaw cawh ahotahmai aa thui tlung be, Thlawpaw thongtah biathuh khah a reipaw a cang.
Canghrasala, bia a phypaw maikaw taco cawngsaw khah thawzaang aa hnui khy nápawtah le thawthonah aa hnui nápawtah le hnawngangnah aa hnui nápawtah cawngsaw khatah aa reipaw a cang.
Rei thuilypaw rei tah a reipaw cawngsaw taco ama le ama a bawkhangpaw a cang, canghrasala bia a phypaw taco khrisawbu khah a bawkhang.

Naaning vytei heh rei thuilypaw tah rei la, tah cawh ka ca dukhui he, canghrasala biaphykhynah hnui la, tah heh ka ca dukhui vy he. A reipaw khah a chingpase tlung ly pawco, bia a phypaw cawngsawpaw cawh rei thuilypaw tah a reipaw navy co, a chahnai vy syly. Ma pawsui co khrisawbu khah tua hry khy a cang a.
Uny sahlo, naaning kha ka vong tihtah Khazing apalynah maw, hnithainah maw, biaphynah maw, chinghringnah maw, rei lytah rei thuilypaw tah ka rei caco, naa cawtah zemaw a chahnai a?
Hringnah a hnui lypaw a ring thaipaw, phipahli, a cang ly leh tingtang sahlo hmai a ningcang teitah aa tung ly caco, ze o maw aa tung tahpaw zekhatamaw aa hni thai a?
Mataico hmoka zong a sepaw tah tung a cang ly caco, ahomaw carae dy ruapaw taco a tho a?
Ma hraco naa rei tihtah thui a nehpaw bia tah naa rei ly caco, zemaw naa rei tahpaw khah zekhatamaw aa hni thai a? Thli letah bia a rei leimeipaw pui naa lo ka tah caw!
Khazaw lehei rei phing hlupui ung he ka, silang a hnui lypaw sangkheh hmai ung bei he.
Mataico, pakhehpaw tei a reipaw rei khah ka thui ly caco, ama cawh ka cawtah mingphing hringpaw cang ka, kama zong a cawtah mingphing hringpaw ka cang hra a.
Ma hraco Thlawpaw lahsong ting naa dunah cawtah khrisawbu a chahnaipaw lahsong ting khah chahnai nge dang my lo.
Ma rawng tahei rei thuilypaw tah a reipaw cawngsaw taco a reipaw khah a chingpase khy nápawtah thlawchang seh.
Zecawtamaw tatah rei thuilypaw tah thlaw ka chang caco, ka thlawpaw tah a changpaw a cang, canghrasala ka thinglung cawh pa chahnai hlui be.
Macawtaco zemaw ka tua a? Ka thlawpaw tah thlawchang neh ka, thuipaw rei zong tah ka chang a, ka thlawpaw tah hlawsah neh ka, thuipaw rei zong tah ka sá a.

Naa thlawpaw tah Khazing naa reithai leimeining takhei naa hrong letei a ungpaw, naa reipaw khah a thui lypaw sahlo taco lawngbia na hlaipaw vytei khah zekhatamaw, “Amen,” aa tah thai a? Zemaw naa rei tahpaw aa thui tlung be!
Naaning taco lawngbia cawh biatah teitah naa hlai thlang, canghrasala, ming hringpaw caw taco a chahnainah ung be.
Naaning vytei navy tah rei thuilypaw tah ka reikhynah cawtah hei Khazing khatah a lawngnah bia ka rei.
Canghrasala, khrisawbu chung leco ming hringpaw cawngpahnah cawtah thui khypaw rei kawpangaw tah rei khah rei thuilypaw kawthonghraw tah rei navy tah ka du vy hri.
Uny sahlo, nyheh sahlo hratei khuarawh khah tai myca o. Chahlynah kong leco nyheh hratah cang la, naa khuarawnah leco puitling cang my lo.
Phungbia letah ciapaw cawh,

content.text: “Rei hringpaw a cuipaw cawngsaw sahlo hmang tah le
raang hringpaw cawngsaw sahlo hmokaw hmang tah
ma cawngsaw sahlo khahei bia ka rei a,
ma hratei ka rei thlang naná teitah hmai ka rei pa nge a bei he,”

content: tatah Abuipaw tah a tah.

Mataico, rei thuilypaw sahlo heh cawh paching pakhanah a cang, zingtu a cangpaw sahlo cawtah cang be, zinglytu sahlo cawtah a cang, ma duitei cawh biaphynah heh cawh zingtu sahlo cawtah a cang, zing ly tu sahlo caw tah cang be.

Macawtaco khrisawbu a pakhongnah letah rei hringpaw tah naa rei thlu caco, a thui lypaw thaikhehpaw a cang ly leh a va chuhpaw a zinglytu sahlo tah ma tlaw heh aa lung hmang khawh be tah a bei he maw?
Canghrasala, bia naa phy leimei chung takhei zinglytu a cang ly leh a thui thai lypaw a za nae tua seh la, a thuipaw bia vytei takhei mehsua a cang zia le biapacepaw a cangpaw khah hnisah a ka,
a lungthing biaparuh vytei zong khah a phy thlu a. Macawtaco, a khuh panai a ka, Khazing khah beh a ka, “Naa hrong letah Khazing a ung hmuisui hi!” tatah a tah a.
Khazing beh ningcang

Mataico uny sahlo, ka rei dupaw cawh ma heh a cang: Hmingkheh letah na pakhong tih he ceh tah hlaw a hnuipaw, cawngpahnah bia a rei dupaw, apalynah a hmuhpaw rei hringpaw tah rei a dupaw, a cang ly leh rei chingpasenah a hnuipaw na ung thlang mai he ceh. Ma vytei heh khrisawbu pacynah cawtah tua cang my seh lo.
Rei thuilypaw tah a reipaw aa ung caco, pahning a cang ly leh a hlu cai tah pathung tah rei he seh la, pakheh khy pakheh rei he seh. Taico, pakheh tah chingpase seh.
A chingpasepaw aa ung ly caco, a pakhongnah leco de teitah ung thlang seh la, ama le Khazing khatah rei thlang my seh lo.
Khazing khuavang pahning pathung tah rei he seh la, ahringpaw takhei aa reipaw khah achaw teitah patlia patla my he seh lo.
Taico, a tythlangpaw khatah apalynah a lang caco, a hmasaw tei bia a reipaw cawh tai my seh lo.
Mingting tah cawngpahnah le pasynah naa hmuh khy ná pawtah pakheh khy pakheh biaphynah hnui my lo.
Khazing khuavang sahlo thlawpaw cawh Khazing khuavang sahlo tah uhpaw a cang.
Zecawtamaw tatah Khazing cawh buaibanah Khazing cang lytah denah Khazing khah a cang hri. Mehpathai sahlo aa khrisawbu vytei letah a cangpaw hratah,
canu sahlo cawh a pungnah leco de teitah ung hrahring my he seh lo. Canu cawh biareinah peh cang kheh he seh. Judah phungbia tah a reipaw hratah canu cawh naw a nge ruapaw a cang he.
Sangkheh kheh hni aa dupaw aa ung caco, ing letah aa pasae leh khah hae thlang he seh, zecawtamaw tatah a pungnah letah canu tei bia rei cawh a ngecang be.
Khazing bia cawh naaning taitah a pathopaw cang be. A cang ly leh Khazing bia tei a phahpaw cawh naaning cy cang bei ceh.
Ahohmai Khazing khuavang a cang ly leh thlawpaw lang lahsong a tingpaw ka cang a tahpaw taco, naaning khatah ka va ciapaw ca heh Abuipaw biapeh a cang, tatah cyhlang my seh lo.
Ma heh zetah a rei ly caco, ama zong zetah rei ly a cang hra a.
Macawtaco ka uny sahlo, biaphy khah du vy la, rei thuilypaw tah rei khah thly khe lo.
Canghrasala, zezongpui khah achaw teitah le a ningcang teitah tua my lo.
